values.note: Campground roads and parking spurs are native soil. The Forest Service gives no rig length (the 32 ft formerly recorded came from an aggregator, go-montana).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/sylvan-lake-campground ('The campground has 5 sites with tables and fire rings. Campground roads and parking spurs are of native soil.'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS (Kootenai NF, Libby RD) campground SE of Libby on Rd #154, on Sylvan Lake; tables and fire rings, native-soil roads and spurs; pack in, pack out. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Apr 30, 2026): confirmed free, 5 sites, vault toilet; added no drinking water. Cleared max_rig_ft 32 (it came from go-montana, an aggregator; FS gives no length). Not stated: FCFS/reservations (derived left), season, stay limit. The page still carries a stale 'THIS CAMPGROUND WILL BE CLOSED IN 2018' line (Moose Peak Fire hazard trees); no current alert for Sylvan Lake or Rd 154 (the flood-washout list names other Libby RD roads). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Rig length: the Forest Service gives none (only 'native soil' roads and spurs), and no review from the last 3 years by someone whose own 23-ft+ rig fit was found (Campendium has no written reviews; an Outdoorithm summary mentions rough road conditions). The 32-ft figure came from an aggregator and was cleared.

Stale page text: Operational Hours still says 'THIS CAMPGROUND WILL BE CLOSED IN 2018. This closure is for hazard tree removal caused by the Moose Peak Fire.' No current closure alert exists; a call to the Libby RD (406) 293-7773 would confirm it is open.
